content: Selected monolingual sentences were then translated using the M2M Transformer NMT model (b3) to compose pseudo-parallel data. Then, the pseudo-parallel data were enlarged by over-sampling as summarized in Table TABREF32 . Finally, new NMT models were trained on the concatenation of the original parallel and pseudo-parallel data from scratch in the same manner as the previous NMT models with the same hyper-parameters.
